- **Clean Database Environments**: Stored ONLY the original `recipe.env` (usually `{}` or clean keys) in the `env` column of `mcp_servers` to prevent leaking the bloated developer shell environment (`childEnv` / `process.env`).

- **Database Partition (`catalog.db`)**: Created a database partition script `split_database.js` to split the massive 25MB scraped catalog tables (`published_mcp_servers`, `published_mcp_config_recipes`, `published_mcp_server_sources`, `pub

- **Attached Multi-Database Validator**: Updated `bulk_validate_mcp_servers.mjs` to attach `catalog.db` dynamically (`ATTACH DATABASE 'catalog.db' AS catalog`) allowing seamless join queries.

- **Commit**: Committed the decoupled script and partitioned SQLite database under the version tag `feat: partition catalog tables to gitignored catalog.db and shrink tormentnexus.db (v1.0.0-alpha.84)`.
- Successfully pushed the clean commit to the primary remote `origin` (`ssh://git@github.com/robertpelloni/TormentNexus.git`).
- Successfully pushed and synchronized to the backup remote `origin-backup` (`https://github.com/robertpelloni/AIOS.git`).
